description: A moody, minimal contemporary kitchen-dining space with a dramatically dark palette. The niche shelves are grazed by subtle warm amber under-shelf lighting, making the dishware glow softly against the dark lattice. Three cylindrical matte-black surface-mounted spots are deployed across the ceiling — one over the niche, two over the kitchen zone — casting focused warm downward pools that accent the cabinetry below. In the foreground, a rectangular dark-brown wood dining table is set with four cream boucle upholstered dining chairs with black wood frames. The table surface holds two white ceramic bowls on white plates and a small pine cone as a decorative centerpiece object. The light oak wide-plank floor is barely visible at the base of frame. Camera is at a slightly elevated-to-standing eye-level, shooting a three-quarter corner view that captures both the left cabinet wall and the back kitchen wall, with the dining table in the foreground.
